purpose: Full snapshot of Tac-Tik's duplicated streams and segments before deduplication (Finding 1 from the validations-banner review), taken via CFG in the live North app immediately before deletion.
background: Unlike the earlier region/gate duplicates, these pairs are TRUE clones -- every field (mix, mktContrib, rateMult, dealMult, addressable, engaged) is identical between the two rows in each pair. This is pure duplicate seed data, not two meaningfully different configurations.
rule_applied: Keep whichever copy of each pair is actually referenced by live data (checked every array in CFG for a field pointing at either id -- campaigns, feeds, regionStreams, campaignPodAllocations, versions, calcScenarios, snapshots, all checked, 0 hits outside campaigns.segmentId). When neither copy is referenced (true for all 5 stream pairs, and for the Unassigned segment pair), keep the first/lower-order copy for consistency, matching the convention used in the gate cleanup.
